rapport_notes: Warm, personable rapport — customer was chatty and rep matched the energy, offered a bonus-for-movers aside about fragile pieces.

evidence_quotes.agenda: "let me go ahead and confirm the details here and also ask you know, some follow up questions about your move" — a soft version of the quid-pro-quo promise, but no dedicated agenda/concerns question was ever asked.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: "I would appreciate if you know, tell anybody at this location yet that we're moving out" (confidentiality concern) got a "Mm-hmm, well yeah, let's go ahead and confirm details" — straight pivot, no follow-up.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: "we will only bill you for the actual hours rendered. So there's only one time you're going to pay and that's after the move is complete."

top_strength: Genuine rapport and adaptability with a talkative, detail-heavy customer.
coaching_note: Sheet 1/2 differentiators (damage coverage, Meet Your Mover) and On-Time Guarantee were never mentioned at all — a full stage-2 miss; also no rep-initiated close ask (customer drove the booking).
